fixture_policy: Implement with synthetic inputs; no existing locked gold contents required.

cases.name: Renamed or copied CSV
cases.given: Protected content is copied under a different path and split=train.
cases.requirement: Membership and content-bound receipt override filenames and role columns.

cases.name: Relabelled event
cases.given: A protected event receives a corrected label, new row ID or report ID.
cases.requirement: Stable source identity and label-independent projections survive the change.

cases.name: Pending to posted
cases.given: A new provider ID is linked to a protected pending observation.
cases.requirement: Verified event aliases carry every prior reservation.

cases.name: Reconnected account
cases.given: A newly linked account ID belongs to an already protected customer/account group.
cases.requirement: Verified alias linkage preserves group separation.

cases.name: Blank merchant
cases.given: An unexposed observation has a blank merchant but verified event/customer/input lineage.
cases.requirement: Blank merchant is supported by v2; legacy exclusions still apply.

cases.name: Unknown identity
cases.given: A candidate has only merchant, amount and date with no recoverable source or customer linkage.
cases.requirement: Do not manufacture an event identity or certify customer isolation.

cases.name: Distinct familiar merchant
cases.given: A distinct eligible input from an unreserved customer has a familiar merchant and no legacy exclusion.
cases.requirement: Merchant familiarity alone is not a core novelty requirement.

cases.name: Late cross-partition alias
cases.given: A verified alias merge joins a learning exposure and a benchmark member.
cases.requirement: Invalidate clean claims and hold promotion; retain all exclusions.

cases.name: Key rotation
cases.given: A protected token is presented through a new HMAC key version.
cases.requirement: Dual-key aliases prevent re-admission; unknown migration status quarantines.

cases.name: Duplicate annotation mappings
cases.given: Returned labels contain missing or duplicate issued job-item IDs.
cases.requirement: No merchant-and-label reconstruction of identity is permitted.

cases.name: Amount bucket collision
cases.given: Two synthetic transactions differ only in amounts 6.99 and 7.49 but have identical direction/text.
cases.requirement: Different exact amounts cannot bypass the effective-input exclusion.

cases.name: Truncation collision
cases.given: Synthetic descriptions differ only after the retained token-48 boundary.
cases.requirement: Compare effective encoded inputs, not only full strings.

cases.name: Unlabelled MLM exposure
cases.given: A proposed benchmark input appeared only in registered MLM inputs.
cases.requirement: Unsupervised exposure counts as learning.

cases.name: New preprocessing version
cases.given: A candidate recipe has a tokenizer/projection version with no held-out projection index.
cases.requirement: Build and verify both sides before fitting or certification.

cases.name: Generic narrative similarity
cases.given: Different customers share a common payment-rail narrative with uncertain near-duplicate status.
cases.requirement: Do not assert they are the same event; report any novelty-driven exclusion.

cases.name: Preprocessing learned on benchmark
cases.given: A vocabulary, vectorizer or mask-statistics proposal includes reserved rows.
cases.requirement: Learned preprocessing is a gated consumer.

cases.name: Every enrichment route
cases.given: One protected example is passed separately to each of the nine consumers.
cases.requirement: No fit, teacher call, rule proposal, prompt or retrieval delivery can consume it.

cases.name: Selection validation overlap
cases.given: A proposed tuning-validation snapshot shares an event, customer or effective input with training/master.
cases.requirement: Selection is an explicit separately reserved role.

cases.name: Retired or unresolved gold
cases.given: A spent, retired, unresolved or failed-labelling benchmark example is offered to training.
cases.requirement: Reservation is permanent across these lifecycle changes.

cases.name: Legacy migration
cases.given: A v1-protected merchant or reviewed family has no matching v2 event ID.
cases.requirement: Migration retains old restrictions.

cases.name: Novel-family reservation
cases.given: A dictionary candidate draws evidence from a reserved novelty family under the registered policy.
cases.requirement: Family reservation applies to enrichment as well as fitting.

cases.name: Changed training bytes
cases.given: A worker receives a valid receipt but a different transformed/augmented fit object.
cases.requirement: Receipts authorize exact consumed content and ancestry.

cases.name: Unknown historical parent
cases.given: A model ancestor lacks actual consumed-source evidence.
cases.requirement: A current regenerated corpus is not proof of historical inputs.

cases.name: Unregistered local fit
cases.given: A model is trained outside the wrappers and submitted for promotion without receipts.
cases.requirement: Promotion independently checks complete lineage.

cases.name: Concurrent reserve and exposure
cases.given: Reservation and learning claims overlap on an event, customer or applicable projection at epoch N.
cases.requirement: The losing operation must re-read and recheck; no stale approval retry.

cases.name: Upload before crash
cases.given: The authority crashes after an object upload but before metadata commit.
cases.requirement: An orphan upload grants no worker access or consumption right.

cases.name: Commit before lost response
cases.given: The authority commits exposure, then loses its response; the same operation retries.
cases.requirement: Exact retries are idempotent and exposure remains recorded.

cases.name: Operation ID reuse
cases.given: An operation ID is reused with different proposal bytes.
cases.requirement: Idempotency cannot authorize a different snapshot.

cases.name: Failed training job
cases.given: A worker may have read admitted inputs before failing.
cases.requirement: Uncertainty never frees consumed or claimed inputs for unseen admission.

cases.name: Authority unavailable
cases.given: The authority, identity key or required registry cannot be read.
cases.requirement: No stale local allow mode.

cases.name: Index compaction
cases.given: Snapshot plus deltas are compacted while admissions continue.
cases.requirement: Prove semantic index equality and publish through the epoch protocol.

cases.name: Confirmation concurrency
cases.given: Two different selected candidates attempt to claim the same sealed reserve.
cases.requirement: Reject the second candidate even if the first has not returned a result.

cases.name: Partial confirmation exposure
cases.given: A run exposes any result then fails and a changed candidate requests a retry.
cases.requirement: The claim is spent; only the same candidate/baseline claim may resume.

cases.name: Benchmark label revision
cases.given: A gold label or adapter changes while comparing a candidate against an old baseline score.
cases.requirement: Keep the original benchmark/version/result; no in-place replacement.

cases.name: Sparse paired results
cases.given: A critical slice has low support or no observed discordances.
cases.requirement: Zero-width resampling is not evidence of non-inferiority.

cases.name: Oversampled headline
cases.given: A scorer combines challenge and representative rows without design weights into a traffic headline.
cases.requirement: Report cohorts separately with correct denominators and sampling weights.

cases.name: Ambiguous retailer credit
cases.given: Synthetic bare retailer credit has no visible evidence distinguishing salary and refund.
cases.requirement: Do not infer gold salary solely from amount or hidden user intent.

cases.name: Zero eligible traffic stratum
cases.given: Effective-input exclusions remove every example in a source stratum.
cases.requirement: Weighting cannot recover zero-support strata.

cases.name: Sealed access boundary
cases.given: A training/runtime identity requests sealed labels or membership fingerprints.
cases.requirement: Verify IAM with the actual service identities; no raw benchmark content in bundles.

cases.name: Cross-customer exact-input link
cases.given: Two distinct verified customers share an applicable effective input before partition assignment.
cases.requirement: Assign the precomputed block to one pool; preserve distinct customer/event IDs and block-aware uncertainty.

cases.name: Late bridge between frozen blocks
cases.given: A later observation links effective-input blocks already assigned to different partitions.
cases.requirement: Do not silently reassign existing partitions or choose a winner by arrival order.

cases.name: Confirmation version reset attempt
cases.given: A spent confirmation cohort is relabelled or republished under a new benchmark version for a different candidate.
cases.requirement: Permanent cohort and event membership preserve the consumed claim across manifest versions.
